{#- The side menu and previous / next, written in each page by the build, so that they work without JavaScript and for the crawlers: menu() in
, pager() in
. Imported with context by base.html. They read the pages of the site in order (site_pages, lhtml_site/menu.py: path, title, section, group; site_pages[pageID] is this page) and the settings `menu` of the `docs` keyword: sections: [names] order of the sections (others follow, in order of first appearance) home_label: label of the first page when it has no section (default 'Home', strings.html) index_label: label of the index page of a section,
/index.html (default 'Overview') section: {: {open: false, the section starts closed (unless the page is in it) groups: closed, its groups start closed, in the lighter style group_link_class: mono, extra class of the links of its groups plain_groups: [names]}} groups whose links do not get that class js/menu.js then applies the open / closed state the reader left (localStorage), and scrolls the menu to the current page. -#} {%- from 'theme/template/strings.html' import t with context -%} {%- set d = docs if docs is defined and docs else {} -%} {%- set cfg = d.menu or {} -%} {#- the URL of a page of the site, each part of its path encoded -#} {%- macro url(entry) %}{{ pathToRoot }}{{ entry.path|urlencode }}{% endmacro -%} {#- the index page of a section:
/index.html -#} {%- macro is_index(entry) %}{{ 'y' if entry.path.endswith('/index.html') and entry.path.count('/') == 1 }}{% endmacro -%} {%- macro link(entry, k, label=none, extra=none) -%} {{ (label or entry.title)|e }} {%- endmacro -%} {#- a collapsible part (section or group): its title (a link to the index page of a section, or text: a click toggles it), then its entries after a vertical line showing the level; `key`: the name of its state, "section" or "section/group" -#} {%- macro part(cls, key, label, href, is_open) -%}
{%- if href %}{{ label|e }}{% else %}{{ label|e }}{% endif -%}
{%- endmacro -%} {%- macro menu() -%} {#- Home: the pages without section -#} {%- for e in site_pages %}{% if not e.section %} {{ link(e, loop.index0, t.home if loop.index0 == 0 else none) }} {%- endif %}{% endfor -%} {#- the sections: those of the settings, then the others in order of their first page -#} {%- set order = [] -%} {%- for s in cfg.sections or [] %}{% if s not in order %}{% set _ = order.append(s) %}{% endif %}{% endfor -%} {%- for e in site_pages %}{% if e.section and e.section not in order %}{% set _ = order.append(e.section) %}{% endif %}{% endfor -%} {%- for section in order -%} {%- set pages = [] -%} {%- for e in site_pages %}{% if e.section == section %}{% set _ = pages.append((e, loop.index0)) %}{% endif %}{% endfor -%} {%- if pages -%} {%- set opt = (cfg.section or {}).get(section) or {} -%} {%- set closed_groups = opt.groups == 'closed' -%} {#- the groups of the section, numbered from 1 as they come (a page with no group after a group stays in it); `current`: the one of the current page (0: none) -#} {%- set g = namespace(group=none, box=0, current=0, index=none, here=false) -%} {%- for e, k in pages -%} {%- if e.group and e.group != g.group %}{% set g.group = e.group %}{% set g.box = g.box + 1 %}{% endif -%} {%- if k == pageID %}{% set g.current = g.box %}{% set g.here = true %}{% endif -%} {%- if g.index is none and is_index(e) %}{% set g.index = e %}{% endif -%} {%- endfor %} {# every section can be collapsed; one with open: false starts closed unless the current page is in it; the index page is its first entry, labelled Overview -#} {{ part('nav-section', section, section, url(g.index) if g.index else none, opt.open is not sameas false or g.here) }} {%- set r = namespace(group=none, box=0) -%} {%- for e, k in pages -%} {%- if e.group and e.group != r.group -%} {%- if r.box %}
{% endif -%} {%- set r.group = e.group %}{% set r.box = r.box + 1 -%} {#- groups: open (nav-subgroup); with groups: closed, closed except the one of the current page, in the lighter style (nav-group) -#} {%- if closed_groups %} {{ part('nav-group', section ~ '/' ~ e.group, e.group, none, r.box == g.current) }} {%- else %} {{ part('nav-subgroup', section ~ '/' ~ e.group, e.group, none, true) }} {%- endif -%} {%- endif %} {{ link(e, k, t.overview if is_index(e) else none, opt.group_link_class if opt.group_link_class and e.group and e.group not in (opt.plain_groups or []) else none) }} {%- endfor -%} {%- if r.box %}{% endif -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- endmacro -%} {#- previous / next, in the order of the site -#} {%- macro pager_link(k, cls, label) -%} {%- if 0 <= k < site_pages|length %} {{ label|e }}{{ site_pages[k].title|e }} {%- endif -%} {%- endmacro -%} {%- macro pager() -%} {{ pager_link(pageID - 1, 'prev', t.previous) }}{{ pager_link(pageID + 1, 'next', t.next) }} {%- endmacro -%}
